list.comment:
test: verify Fortify auth, token API, and habit flows with full green suite
Confirm system stability after auth and routing refactors.
- All Fortify authentication flows passing (login, register, logout) - Token-based API authentication fully validated - Profile and password update tests passing - Habit CRUD and validation tests passing - Ensure session regeneration, hashing, and validation rules work as expected

task.summary: Default task

fix(ci): stabilize tests with in-memory SQLite and align assertions
Resolve CI failures caused by test database and assertion mismatches.
- Configure PHPUnit to use SQLite in-memory database - Remove dependency on external DB service in CI - Fix date assertions to match SQLite datetime format - Adjust boolean assertions to reflect SQLite storage behavior - Ensure all tests pass reliably in

Introduce interactive API documentation for Smart Planner.
- Add OpenAPI 3.0 specification for Habit API - Include Swagger UI (5.11.0) for interactive testing - Add localhost development server (http://localhost:8043/api) - Configure docs for GitHub Pages (.nojekyll) - Document auth, schemas, validation, and endpoints

feat(auth): add custom JSON-based API authentication and update frontend login
Replace redirect-based auth with API-friendly authentication flow.
- Add AuthController with JSON login/logout/user endpoints - Expose /api/auth/login, /api/auth/logout, and /api/auth/user routes - Update habits API routes under auth middleware - Update frontend to use /auth/login and handle JSON responses - Remove redirect-dependent login logic for SPA compatibility

refactor(auth): remove Laravel Fortify and two-factor authentication
Simplify authentication by removing Fortify and 2FA support.
- Remove Fortify service provider, config, and actions - Drop TwoFactorAuthenticatable trait from User model - Delete Fortify-related routes and controllers - Clean up frontend pages and components tied to Fortify - Align auth flow with custom JSON-based API authentication

fix(auth): finalize Sanctum SPA login flow with CSRF and CORS support
Stabilize cookie-based authentication between React SPA and Laravel API.
- Ensure CSRF cookie is fetched via /sanctum/csrf-cookie - Exclude XSRF-TOKEN from cookie encryption - Align CORS config for credentials with specific frontend origin - Configure session and Sanctum domains for cross-port auth - Update frontend request headers to include XSRF token - Use JSON-based /api/auth/login endpoint without redirects

chore(devtools): add IDE Helper and Debugbar for local development
Install development-only tooling to improve DX.
- Add barryvdh/laravel-ide-helper for better IDE autocompletion - Add barryvdh/laravel-debugbar for runtime debugging - Restrict both packages to dev environment

test: skip web-only settings and dashboard tests for API-based app
Align test suite with SPA + API architecture.
- Skip profile, password, and dashboard feature tests - Remove failures caused by missing web routes - Keep API and habit tests active and passing - Reflect React-driven frontend instead of Blade pages

chore(frontend): enforce Prettier formatting and fix CI format step
Standardize frontend code style and stabilize formatting checks.
- Configure Prettier with single quotes, 2-space indent, and LF endings - Format all JS/JSX source files - Ensure npm run format matches GitHub Actions expectations - Prevent CI failures caused by inconsistent code style

fix(ci): force PHPUnit to use in-memory SQLite instead of MariaDB
Prevent CI failures caused by missing database service.
- Set DB_CONNECTION=sqlite in phpunit.xml - Use DB_DATABASE=:memory: for fast, isolated tests - Remove dependency on MariaDB in test environment - Ensure all tests run reliably in CI

fix(security): remove vulnerable frontend dependencies and resolve audit issues
Eliminate prototype pollution and other npm vulnerabilities.
- Remove unused packages (sort-by, match-sorter, localforage) - Drop transitive object-path dependency - Update react-router-dom to patched version - Run npm audit fix to clean remaining issues - Verify zero vulnerabilities in package-lock.json

feat(docker): add Node 25 base images and simplify router layout graph
Introduce Node 25 Docker setup and clean up React Router layout hierarchy.
- Add Dockerfiles using official Node 25 base image - Align frontend build/runtime with modern Node version
- Remove redundant AppLayout - Keep ShellLayout as UI frame (sidebar + main) - Keep ProtectedLayout as auth gate - Prevent sidebar from leaking onto /login - Restore single-responsibility routing tree

feat(habits-ui): replace toy list with sortable CRUD table
Upgrade habits screen to real management UI.
- Render habits as a table (title, frequency, status, actions) - Add client-side sorting by title, frequency, and status - Add actions: edit, complete, delete - Wire all actions to REST API endpoints - Make UI reflect real backend state instead of static list

feat(habits): replace list with table view and add create habit flow
- Render habits in a sortable, structured table - Add global “Add Habit” button - Integrate CreateHabitForm with inline toggle - Wire up reload after create, complete, and delete actions - Improve UX with empty state and confirmation on delete

feat(docs,router,tests): sync OpenAPI, fix error layout scope, and harden test safety
Deliver production-grade API docs, correct router error boundaries, and protect dev data.
- Add all auth and user routes to OpenAPI spec with schemas and security - Document login, register, logout, and current-user endpoints - Keep habits endpoints fully described - Add localhost server to OpenAPI for local testing
- Move errorElement from ShellLayout to ProtectedLayout - Keep sidebar visible when route errors occur - Contain errors to the main content area only
- Add hard safety check to tests to prevent running on MariaDB - Enforce SQLite in-memory database for test runs - Abort tests if a real database is detected - Restore seed data after accidental wipe

ci(security): add GitGuardian secret scanning workflow
Introduce automated secret detection across the entire repository.
- Add GitGuardian GitHub Actions workflow - Scan both backend and frontend codebases - Run on pushes to main/develop and on pull requests - Use full git history for accurate detection - Block CI when secrets are found

feat(profile,router): split profile into modular pages and update routing
Replace monolithic Profile page with a structured profile area.
- Add ProfileLayout with nested profile routes - Introduce ProfileView, ProfileEdit, EmailChange, and PasswordChange pages - Add profile context for shared user state - Remove legacy Profile.jsx - Update router configuration to support nested profile navigation

feat(auth): integrate Laravel Fortify and split app into API + SPA flows
Reintroduce Fortify with JSON-first responses to support both mobile API and React SPA authentication.
- Add Fortify service provider, config, and action classes - Implement JSON responses for login, register, logout, password reset, email verification, and two-factor auth - Expose API auth endpoints alongside web routes - Update User model and factories for Fortify features - Configure CORS and middleware for SPA + mobile clients
- Update React app to support: - registration, login, and password reset - email verification flow - two-factor authentication (challenge + setup) - protected routing based on Fortify session state
- Add route loaders and auth context to unify SPA and API auth state

chore(api): refine resources, Fortify JSON responses, and OpenAPI docs
Improve API consistency and documentation.
- Add UserResource for standardized user payloads - Refine Habit and HabitLog API resources - Improve Fortify JSON response objects for auth and 2FA flows - Align all responses with API schema - Update OpenAPI spec to reflect current response formats

chore(api): refine resources, Fortify JSON responses, and OpenAPI docs

refactor(routing): split frontend and API routes and align habit forms
Separate navigation concerns from API endpoints.
- Introduce frontend route map in src/routes.js - Add API-only route map in src/api/routes.js - Update CreateHabitForm to use API routes - Update HabitEditForm and HabitForm to avoid frontend routes for API calls - Fix Habits page and ProfileView to use correct route sources - Add enum-backed habit type and frequency on backend - Align models, migrations, and controllers with enum usage
